title: The Lord's Hand and the Redeemer to Zion
description: The prophet Isaiah explains that the Lord's hand is not too short to save, but that the people's sins have separated them from God. He describes widespread injustice, violence, and lies, and the people's complaint that justice is far away. When the Lord sees that no one intervenes, his own arm brings him salvation: He puts on righteousness as a breastplate, the helmet of salvation, the garments of vengeance, and zeal. A Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from their sins, and the Lord establishes an eternal covenant concerning his Spirit and his words.
